How to download your broadcasts
To download your broadcasts, log into your Periscope account on the web and visit the
page.

To request your data, select Send Data Request below the first of three dots you’ll see at the top of the dashboard. Once your request is complete, scroll down to see a list of your broadcasts, and click the Download button next to any broadcast you wish to download locally to your computer.
The Download links will be valid for 7 days. Once the links expire, you can click Send Data Request again, which will include your most recent data.

What if I delete my >x< account or change my phone number?

Your >x< account, Facebook account, Google account, or phone number (depending on which you used to sign up) is the key to your Periscope account. A >x< account can only access one Periscope account the same way that a phone number can only access one Periscope account. If you lose access to account you use to log into your account or change your phone number, you will not be able to access your Periscope account.
